A pressure gauge is lowered into the sea. Measurements of the pressure and depth are taken as
the pressure gauge is lowered.
Which statement describes how and why the pressure changes as the gauge is lowered?

options.text: The density of the sea water decreases so the pressure increases.
The depth of the gauge below the surface of the sea increases so the pressure increases.
The height of the gauge above the sea bed decreases so the pressure decreases.
The temperature of the sea water decreases so the pressure decreases.

options.text: Molecules break free from their fixed positions.
Freely moving molecules collide and join together.
Molecules escape from the surface of a liquid.
Freely moving molecules gain energy and move further apart.
